svg.text: Server Ops · Quiet Triage & Proactive Rescue

g.text: Alert just fired: Singapore reverse proxy is returning 502. Check the last 10m Nginx logs.
Fast-Read · Lead Bot & EggBot: Live incident log triage, unrelated to app code—staying quiet
Found it—upstream Node process OOM-restarted and dropped sockets.
Should I run systemctl restart nginx and wipe /var/cache/nginx/* to reset?
Hold off on hard restart and cache wipe! Use this ops connection to capture a heap snapshot
and run a graceful reload so we keep OOM evidence intact:
Good catch! Captured heap dump via ops-ssh-sg and reloaded gracefully—200 OK restored.
